bindings.qualification: Reference kind is native_mechanistic_simulation. All native CSVs are headerless. Lab has10000 simulated compositions; pilot test has15 physical experiments, while train/validation have48/12 interpolated rows. Repeated pilot measurements underpin interpolation and cannot establish independence. Native source-full pilot files have1016/982 rows and are excluded from joining. Lab/pilot target spaces differ (129 molecular components versus10 bulk properties); no artificial matched cross-scale pairing.
bindings.reference_evidence: Author README defines first4 process columns and129 feed components. Native Bulk_prop.py returns dry gas,LPG,gasoline,diesel,coke in that order, then5 gasoline PIONA endpoints. Article methods identify infrared carbon-sulfur analysis of coke; original15 pilot experiments reserved for testing and interpolation used for training/validation.

reactor_scale_modeling.split_policy: Do not treat interpolation descendants of the same fifteen pilot experiments as independent held-out experimental evidence.
